name: skill-claude-code-codex-ads
title_zh: 四个静态广告技能打包，单人团队都能跑
tagline_zh: Claude Code 和 Codex 都能装，两个单人用、两个真团队用，还带一个广告第二大脑。不用写代码。
tagline_en: Install once, run on Claude Code & Codex. Two for solo, two for real teams, plus an ad second brain. Static.
desc_en: Four all-in-one static advertising skills for Claude Code and Codex: two solo, two real-team, with an integrated advertising second brain.
why_zh: 不是零散脚本，是成套工作流：技能之间共享记忆，单人模式不装协作负担，团队模式自带分工边界。
why_en: Not scattered scripts but a workflow suite: skills share memory, solo modes skip team overhead, team modes enforce role.
limit_zh: 只覆盖静态广告站点生成，不含动态后端、A/B 测试或广告投放 API 对接。
limit_en: Static ad site generation only—no dynamic backends, A/B testing, or ad API integrations. Requires Claude Code or Codex and basic CLI comfort.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: 4 static ad skills for solo or team
